product.tagline: Toggle peak matching for Ableton tracks
product.description: GainSnap measures an incoming track peak while Match is enabled, applies the gain needed to reach a chosen target when Match is disabled, and holds that gain until the next measurement. Normalize sets the target to 0 dBFS and starts Match in one click. The vertical meter shows the latest block peaks in realtime: the orange column is the incoming (IN) level, and the cyan column is the adjusted (OUT) level. A small triangle beside the meter marks the target and acts as the target control.
